title: Kissed Ukrainian Quinoa Bowl
description: A funky, aerated bowl of fluffy quinoa topped with roasted beetroot, creamy cabbage slaw, and a maple‑kombu glaze, perfect for a high‑protein Ukrainian‑inspired lunch.
instructions: Rinse quinoa until water runs clear, then combine with water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer quinoa for 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed and grains are fluffy.
While quinoa cooks, roast beetroot at 400°F for 25 minutes until tender, then cube and set aside.
In a bowl, mix shredded cabbage, julienne carrot, and fresh dill.
Whisk olive oil, maple syrup, kombu cold extract, salt, and pepper together to create a glaze.
When quinoa is done, fluff with a fork and transfer to serving bowls.
Drizzle the maple‑kombu glaze over the quinoa and arrange roasted beetroot and cabbage slaw on top.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with extra dill.
Enjoy a light, high‑protein Ukrainian bowl with a modern twist.
